name: bcm-data-exports
description: You can use the Data Exports API to create customized exports from multiple Amazon Web Services cost management and billing datasets, such as cost and usage data and cost optimization recommendations.

subcommands.name: create-export
subcommands.description: Creates a data export and specifies the data query, the delivery preference, and any optional resource tags.

subcommands.name: get-execution
subcommands.description: Exports data based on the source data update.

subcommands.name: get-export
subcommands.description: Views the definition of an existing data export.

subcommands.name: get-table
subcommands.description: Returns the metadata for the specified table and table properties.

subcommands.name: list-executions
subcommands.description: Lists the historical executions for the export.

subcommands.name: list-tables
subcommands.description: Lists all available tables in data exports.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: List tags associated with an existing data export.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds tags for an existing data export definition.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Deletes tags associated with an existing data export definition.

subcommands.name: update-export
subcommands.description: Updates an existing data export by overwriting all export parameters.
